note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: The owners of a family-owned packaging manufacturer have received an offer of $96 million for the business. Its EBITDA last year was $12 million.

answers.common.decision: Whether to accept the offer or counter; the owners decide.
answers.common.deadline: The buyer wants an answer in three weeks.
answers.common.materials: Comparable packaging deals traded at 9.5x EBITDA. The company carries net debt of $18 million, which would be repaid from the sale proceeds.
answers.finance-modeling.purpose: Value the business against comparable deals and show what the owners would receive.
answers.finance-modeling.data: Last year's financial statements and a list of comparable packaging deals, in US dollars.
